The automated acquisition restriction and distinct conditional Public Materials reuse provisions were separately inspected. No standard fetch followed the restriction.
A free-to-download handbook is not assumed licensed for all operations; Copyright Office case-specific guidance supports avoiding automatic paraphrase or quantity clearance.
No artifact hash is invented for a link-only reference; revised text/terms trigger a scoped new review rather than inherited permission.
